text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0840 CDT.

CANOLA - Steady to C$1.00 lower on CBOT soycomplex calls, expected local and hedge selling with losses limited by over sold sentiments and technical support seen in the July at C$401 a tonne. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +0.34 Monday from -0.26 Friday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3754 versus the U.S. dollar, and rose to 84.48 yen and 1.2307 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 down on allied markets with commercials expected to buy July scale down on early hedges.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.10 to C$0.50 down in old crop with demand for the July seen down to C$134.60 a tonne. July-Oct was expected to continue spreading at C$0.10.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.10 to C$0.60 lower on U.S. wheat calls and WCE feed grain calls.
FEED PEAS - Steady with commercial interest seen in the October at US$186.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
